name: Mahou no Shougakusei Clit-chan
original_name: 魔法の小学生クリットちゃん
source:
A letter comes to a man living alone. It's an invitation to a magic girl academy for a week with the freedom to do whatever he wishes there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-april-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一封信写给一个独居男子。这是一份前往魔法少女学院为期一周的邀请，可以在那里自由地做任何他想做的事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-april-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
